chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama'ah, from Ibn Faddal, from al-Qasim ibn 'Urwah, from Burayd, from one of the two عليهما السلام, who said:
When the redness disappears from the east, then the sun has indeed set from the east of the earth and its west.

key_terms.الْحُمْرَةُ: the red glow or redness seen in the sky

ai.seo_question: How is sunset recognized in Shia hadith for determining the time of salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a sign for the onset of sunset by linking it to the disappearance of the eastern redness. It is used in determining the time related to salat (prayer), especially the legal recognition of sunset.
